name: Albuquerque
local_rules: Albuquerque (ABQ) is unique: while the City issues the tickets, the Metropolitan Court adjudicates them. You must request a hearing in person or via mail to the Lomas NW address. Contesting the citation does NOT stop the fine from doubling or tripling if you lose. If a $20 ticket isn't resolved, it jumps to $40, then $60. Always include a copy of the citation and a clear 'Request for Hearing' statement.
